messages:
marta (Sales): FYI inbound from NomiFin — they want Dedicated capacity for a fraud-detection chat assistant. asked for numbers + SLA, copying the intake below.

nora (Customer): Hi Redwood team — our peak events spike usage. target p95 latency <= 1.2s for chat (avg output ~200 tokens), steady qps ~50, burst up to ~150 qps for ~20-40 minutes during end-of-quarter runs. model: opt-13b (we want a tuned open model) at 4-bit quant. private VPC and KMS, must not fall back to hosted models. looking for cost estimate + autoscale/burst plan and canary rollout. timeline: go-live in 6 weeks. can provide load-test harness.

marta (Sales): ask: can product/eng give a sizing sketch and list open questions? customer wants committed reserved pool vs burstable — their procurement leans toward a predictable monthly commit but also needs burst.

anya (Product): Thanks — quick clarifying Qs: 1) "avg output 200 tokens" is that tokens generated per request or tokens total (including prompt)? 2) expected concurrency of concurrent users (not qps) during peak? 3) are there function calls or heavy reranking per request? we should capture eval prompts.

nora (Customer): tokens = generated tokens on avg 200, prompt ~60 tokens. concurrency ~600 active users during peak (their app fans out requests), so roughly maps to the qps numbers above. occasional rerank step (~10% of requests).

evan (Eng Runtime): Initial sizing sketch (very rough): opt-13b 4-bit quant -> our internal perf suggests ~60-80 reqs/sec per A100-80GB equiv for 260-token total (prompt+gen). For 50 qps steady -> 1 node (but need redundancy), for 150 qps burst -> ~3 nodes. factoring concurrency and KV cache pressure + 20% headroom -> Recommend reserved pool of 2 nodes + burstable pool of 2 additional nodes (pre-warmed) to cover 150 qps.

samir (SRE): We need to decide burst mechanism: 1) reserved nodes + pre-warmed cold-start
